description:
🌌 Dynamic Asteroids
Breathes kinetic life into static asteroid belts & deep space combat!

Game Version: Starsector 0.98a-RC8 (Supports 0.97a) | Compatibility: Java 8 (Vanilla & Custom JREs)
Required Dependency: LunaLib | Mod Author & Contact (Discord): keltuze

📦 DOWNLOADS (v2.0.62 Latest Release)

📥 Download Standard Edition (EN) [v2.0.62]
📥 Скачать русскую версию (RU) [v2.0.62]

🔗 GitHub Repository & Releases | 💾 Safe to add or remove mid-campaign.

🚀 About The Mod
In vanilla Starsector, asteroids just hang motionless in space as static environmental obstacles. Dynamic Asteroids completely transforms combat battlefields into active, roaring rivers of cosmic debris, tactical hazard zones, interactive derelict recovery operations, and kinetic survival challenges.

✨ Core Features & What's New in v2.0.62

• 🪐 Colossal Megaliths & Shatter Loot:
- Massive station-sized boulders (radii up to 550 units, diameters exceeding 1100 units) now drift into battle with immense bedrock durability.
- Interactive Newtonian Physics: Ram or shoot megaliths to "untether" them into full Newtonian bodies. Push and bulldoze them across the battlefield using your ship's thrusters or shields to create portable cover against torpedo strikes!
- Megalith Shatter Rewards: Concentrating fleet fire to crack open a giant megalith can break loose valuable treasures frozen inside its core:
* High chance (20%) to drop Domain supply caches, survey probes, or cryopods.
* Chance (1.5%) to recover an intact fighter craft and its LPC chip directly into your fleet cargo.
* Rare chance (0.1%) to free an ancient entombed derelict ship hull for recovery!
- Orbital Arc Flight: Megaliths can travel along smooth gravitational curves, mimicking hyperbolic flybys across the battlefield.

• 🛡� Station Deflection Domes & Overload Vulnerability:
- Orbital stations project a holographic deflector barrier that smoothly diverts incoming asteroid rivers around the station.
- Vulnerability Window: If a combat platform or station module suffers flux overload (Overload), vents flux, or gets destroyed, the deflector dome collapses with EMP arcs, leaving the station exposed to kinetic asteroid bombardment!

• 🚀 Fleet Deployment Grace Period:
- During the first 7 seconds of battle and within fleet deployment zones, all allied ships are protected by deflector dampers (0.0x collision damage). No more unfair asteroid hits before touching the throttle.

• 🧲 Directional Shield Tractor Beams & Mooring Physics:
- Active shields act as tractor beams. Directional shields pull targets within their active forward arc, while 360° omni-shields and phase cloaks pull from all directions.
- Features quadratic mass contrast (frigates pull themselves toward massive hulls; capitals reel in cargo without shuddering) and zero-elasticity velocity damping at the mooring perimeter.

• ⚓ Derelict Ship Rescue Operations:
- Abandoned hulls (including modded ships!) drift through debris fields with live HUD tracking. Protect them for 60 seconds from incoming hazards to guarantee recovery on the post-battle Salvage Screen!

• 📦 Interactive Debris & Volatile Fuel Tanks:
- Contact with drifting Domain caches, probes, and cryopods transfers loot directly to cargo.
- Drifting orange fuel tanks detonate with massive 1200 HE blast waves when shot or rammed. Friendly PD turrets automatically target dangerous rocks while sparing valuable salvage.

• 🎛� Five Live LunaLib Presets (F2):
- Switch on the fly: Cinematic Soft (scenic, fragile debris), Balanced Standard (600 u/s, tactical gameplay), Asteroid Storm (1200 u/s, dense waves), Extreme Chaos (3000 u/s hypervelocity!), or Custom (full manual slider control).

⌨️ Refit Simulator & Testing Hotkeys
(<Strictly active only in the refit simulator to prevent campaign exploits>)
• [/] — Toggle asteroid stream ON / OFF
• ['] — Spawn a test drifting derelict ship nearby
• [;] — Spawn a test Domain cache / probe / fuel tank
• [L] — Spawn a colossal megalith boulder (curved arc flight)
• [Shift + / -] — Increase or decrease asteroid stream capacity
• [Ctrl + / -] — Increase or decrease asteroid stream velocity

📜 Version History & Changelogs

v2.0.62 — Colossal Megaliths, Station Domes & Sector Map Fixes
v2.0.62 Update Highlights:
• Colossal Megaliths: Introduced giant planetoid-scale boulders (diameters up to 1100u) with pushable Newtonian physics and curved gravitational slingshot orbits.
• Megalith Shatter Loot: Shattering giant megaliths drops high-tier Domain caches (20%), preserved fighter LPC chips (1.5%), or entombed derelict hulls (0.1%).
• Station Deflection Domes: Orbital stations project deflector fields that part asteroid streams. Module flux overload or destruction collapses the shield, leaving the station exposed.
• Deployment Grace Period: Added 7 seconds of collision damage immunity upon entering battle with deflector visual cues.
• Formation Wave Density Buff: "Expanding Fan" and "Dual Rails" formations reinforced with +20 to +40 asteroids per stream with tighter firing cadence.
• Campaign Map Detection Fix: Battles in empty ring gaps or non-hazardous fine dust rings no longer trigger asteroid hazards — only physical asteroid fields do.
• Fixed Left Border Flickering Line: Resolved engine reflection conflict with obfuscated classes, permanently clearing vanilla 1-pixel border asteroid generators.
• Repellor Boundary Sync: Asteroids and debris drifting past combat border repellors now cleanly despawn after 5 seconds.

v2.0.6 — FixMagneto & Interactive Salvage Operations
v2.0.6 Update Highlights:
• Shield Tractor Beam Overhaul (FixMagneto): Rewrote magnetic attraction into a closed-loop relativistic mooring system. Directional shields now pull strictly within active arcs; added quadratic Newtonian mass scaling and pure velocity damping at shield perimeters.
• Derelict Rescue Operations: Added drifting SOS derelicts with HUD trackers, 60-second stabilization timers, and guaranteed post-battle salvage recovery.
• Interactive Easter Eggs: Domain supply caches, geological probes, cryopods, and fighter LPCs drift through fields.
• Volatile Fuel Tanks: 1200 HE explosive canisters detonate upon impact or weapon strikes.
• Deep Space Encounters: Stray meteors and rare anomalies wander through deep space battles outside belts.
• Smart PD Whitelist: Point defense intercepts hazardous rocks while sparing valuable loot containers.

v2.0.0 — Cyclone Edition (360° Formations & Visual Trails)
v2.0.0 Update Highlights:
• Living Macro-Drift: Added continuous background orbital avalanche simulating realistic planetary ring drift.
• 360° Tactical Formations: Complex high-density formations slice across the sector every 25–35s (Meteor Lances, Comet Swarms, Dual Rails, Expanding Fans, Megalith Packs) from up to 3 simultaneous angles.
• Targeted Sniper Torrents (5% Chance): Formations can target ships directly with combat log alarms.
• Kinetic Particle Trails: Golden spark glints, cyan comet dust, and crimson plasma trails.
• Fluid Performance: Optimized simulation supporting 200–300 asteroids at 120 FPS.
• Simulator Test Hotkeys: Added controls for testing density and stream toggles.

v1.0.0 — Initial Release
v1.0.0 Features:
• First release introducing active kinetic asteroid streams in Starsector combat.
• Automatic cleanup of vanilla static asteroids at battle start.
• Fixed 600 u/s velocity lock and collision bounce resets.
• Density rolls (70–160 rocks) and 1 of 4 cardinal flow directions.
• Flagship HUD direction indicator.

Click above to check out the 1000x rock density stress test!|

Click above to watch Dynamic Asteroids 2.0 in action!

If you are enjoying Dynamic Asteroids and want to leave a small $1 tip (or any amount) to support my work, you can do it here. Every bit of support means the world to me!

👉 Leave a Tip on Boosty / Поддержать на Boosty

🤖 AI Transparency & Development Disclaimer
In full transparency: All Java code in this mod was machine-generated through iterative architectural prompting and dialogue with an AI assistant (Google Antigravity / Gemini). The human author acted as creative director, game designer, and QA tester: designing mechanics, diagnosing engine collision quirks, directing physics models, fine-tuning gameplay balance, and overseeing save compatibility.

discordPostHtml:
Breathes life into static asteroid belts!
In vanilla Starsector, asteroids just hang motionless in space. Dynamic Asteroids turns them into active, rushing rivers of space debris during combat.

Terrain Detection: Uses the campaign world map to strictly check if your fleet is inside an asteroid belt, field, or planetary ring (ASTEROID_BELT, ASTEROID_FIELD, RING).
Asteroid Fields / Belts:
Continuous Stream: Asteroids rush across the map along 1 of 4 cardinal directions (Left, Right, Up, Down — rolled 25% each at battle start).
Density: 70 to 160 rocks rolled once per combat. (new update 100-1000)
HUD Hazard Alert: The flagship's HUD displays the current drift direction and active field rock count.
Deep Space / Open Space (Outside Asteroid Belts):
Sparse Meteors: Only 4 to 10 stray rocks in the entire sector.
Irregular Spacing: Spawns with a randomized delay between 1.5s and 5.0s, ensuring rocks drift by sporadically one by one rather than forming a solid wave.
Quiet HUD: Shows calm situational info without emergency alarms.
Refit Simulator: Always models a full asteroid storm so you can stress-test ship shields and point defense.
Anti-Brake Cruise Control: Prevents physics engine collision dampening from stalling the rocks — asteroids actively maintain speed after impacts.
30-Second Lifespan: Asteroids expire gracefully with a soft dust puff after 30 seconds, preventing sector clutter and preserving FPS.
Mid-Campaign Safe: 100% safe to add or remove at any point in an ongoing campaign (pure combat engine plugin, writes zero data to save files).

Stress Test https://youtu.be/mda3KVTvqBE more asteroid!
https://github.com/keltuze/DynamicAsteroids#-how-it-works

p.s I hereby grant the game developers full, unrestricted rights to use, modify, and integrate the concepts, assets, and code from this mod into the official game. I would be absolutely thrilled to see these "crazy asteroids" become a native part of the universe.
